verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents running evals in CI/CD on every pull request and integrating experiments into pipelines. It also provides a headless `bt` CLI and an `npx braintrust eval` command authenticated via the BRAINTRUST_API_KEY env var, plus a full programmatic API, so automation without the UI is clearly supported. missing for 10: concrete CI configuration docs (e.g., a ready-made CI action, exit-code/threshold gating details), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Automate in CI/CD — Run evals on every pull request to catch regressions
Run them from code or in the UI, track progress over time, and integrate into CI/CD to catch regressions before they reach production.
lets you run experiments programmatically, and lets you integrate evals into your CI/CD pipeline
It lets you authenticate, trace coding-agent sessions, run evals, browse and query logs, sync data, and manage functions without leaving your terminal.
The Braintrust API allows you to interact with all aspects of the Braintrust platform programmatically.
